review_sampling: Original paired raw recordings: seven predetermined evenly spaced source instants per take for initial review; additional inspected intervals explicitly logged, never claim unseen frames absent.
candidate_selection: At most three timestamped examples, ascending demo ID among reviewed candidates with clear additional state/style information. Prefer distinct decision/state distinctions rather than duplicate same-event examples; lock selection before inspecting per-candidate feature behavior.
negative_control: demo_0007: intermediate motion not shown necessary by VIDEO10
authority_rule: Separate task-required pickup/no-unnecessary-manipulation if explicitly in existing instructions from human style and externally imposed constraints. Do not invent required pauses/routes/obstacles from a human movement.
decision: One acceptance decision, with unsupported/unreviewed meaning not established, not absent.
